frequency_policy: Original hard interval [4,6]; within interval values equally satisfy goal; not a maximize/minimize objective.
precision_reason: Return/return-loss steps0.001 mean0.1 percentage point; drawdown steps0.0001 mean0.01 percentage point; concentration step0.01 means1 percentage point of positive net PnL. These are declared comparison granularity, not statistical error bounds.
comparison: Lower Pareto layer first. Within layer compare declared binned metrics lexicographically; first unequal known metric decides. Missing value at an earlier tied prefix makes that pair incomparable; never skip or impute it.
ties: All seven binned values known and equal means economic display tie; config ID is display-only.
partial_ranks: Minimum possible ordinal position = strict ancestors+1; maximum = layer size-strict descendants. Exact rank only if bounds coincide; tied entries share their minimum position. Missing metrics may be disclosed even when an earlier metric decides a pair.
